summary: Smoke frontend E2E R07 (marketplace USDT) + R02 (redemption reject/reactivate). R07-UI, R07-E2E, R07-insufficient PASS. R02 reject and reactivate PASS. R02 insufficient-reactivate: backend correctly returns 409 with friendly message, BUT frontend shows an 'Uncaught runtime error' overlay instead of a toast — AdminWithdrawals.updateRedemption has no try/catch and does not surface 409 errors.

ui_bugs.issue: PUT /api/admin/redemptions/{id}/status has no try/catch. When backend returns 409 (e.g., insufficient balance to reactivate a rejected canje, or lost race condition), React surfaces an 'Uncaught runtime error' dev overlay and no toast is shown. The friendly detail 'El cliente no tiene X USDT para reactivar este canje (ya gastó el reembolso).' is never displayed. Must wrap in try/catch and toast.error(extractDetailMessage(e)).

The ✓ (approved), ⇪ (delivered), ✕ (rejected) buttons per redemption row lack data-testid (only glyph text). Makes E2E targeting fragile; recommend adding data-testid="redemption-status-{approved|delivered|rejected}-{id}".

action_items: Wrap AdminWithdrawals.updateRedemption in try/catch: toast.error(extractDetailMessage(e)) so 409 (insufficient balance / race) shows a friendly toast instead of Uncaught runtime error.
Add data-testid to redemption row action buttons (approve/deliver/reject) in RedemptionsTable.jsx for stable automation.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminWithdrawals.jsx: updateRedemption() is the only status handler without error handling; every peer function (createDelivery, markPickupReady, applyCourierFee) wraps axios in try/catch. Inconsistent + user-visible bug.
Confirmed: MarketplaceView.jsx correctly picks balances.balances[code==='USDT'].amount (R07). Prices, dialog total and equivalents all in USDT. Widget testid marketplace-balance-usdt.
Backend routes/orders.py POST /vip/redeem correctly writes settlement_currency='USDT' and debits vip_balances.USDT by total+courier_fee_usd.

success_rate.frontend: 90% — 4/5 flows fully green; 1 flow (insufficient-reactivate 409 handling) shows runtime error overlay

context_for_next_testing_agent: R07 marketplace (USDT settlement) verified end-to-end via UI. R02 reject+reactivate happy-path verified. Only remaining gap: friendly 409 toast on reactivation without balance (backend already emits correct 409 payload {detail: 'El cliente no tiene 103.3 USDT ...'}, needs FE try/catch).
rca of the issue: AdminWithdrawals.jsx L189-193 defines updateRedemption without try/catch and calls toast.success unconditionally. When axios rejects (409 for R02 reactivation with insufficient balance, or 409 race), the promise rejection is unhandled → React error boundary/dev overlay surfaces. Repro: reject a redemption → drain vip_balances.{settlement_currency} to 0 → click ✓ (approved). Mitigation: wrap in try/catch, use extractDetailMessage(e) helper already used elsewhere in the same file.
